subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should WebChat `chat.send` ACK require eager durable user-turn persistence before the serialized agent lane, and should PR 80670 be ported/reworked as the canonical fix for this issue family?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses the gateway durable transcript boundary, WebChat optimistic UI behavior, and runtime duplicate suppression, so automation should not choose the permanent contract while an open candidate PR and canonical overlapping issues already exist.

options.title: Rework PR 80670 as canonical
options.body: Use the existing branch direction, but require a current-main port, duplicate-suppression proof, and gateway/WebChat upgrade tests before merge.

options.title: Keep runtime-lane persistence only
options.body: Leave ACK semantics unchanged and document the issue as expected until a narrower UI-only reproduction proves a separate bug.

options.title: Close as duplicate of broader session work
options.body: Move all remaining discussion to the broader WebChat/session-state issue cluster if maintainers do not want this symptom tracked separately.

recommendation.title: Rework PR 80670 as canonical
recommendation.body: Use the existing branch direction, but require a current-main port, duplicate-suppression proof, and gateway/WebChat upgrade tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The central unresolved choice is the user-turn recorder and durable persistence contract rather than only Control UI rendering.
